prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1436; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on a main road in Sugar Land, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I had come to a stop at a light.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from the back and my head snapped forward, then back against the seat.

Q: Did you have your seatbelt on?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: No, they didn't. The car was drivable at first, but it wasn't comfortable.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?

A: I got out, but my right knee was throbbing. It hit the dashboard when I was thrown forward. I could walk, but with a limp.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor because of the swelling.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Stairs are hard, and I can't kneel the way I used to. I've been using a brace when I go out.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd appreciate a prompt response on the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
